This is the '''bullet''' template; it looks like this: [&nbsp;&bull;&nbsp;]

It works similarly to the HTML markup sequence: [<code>'''&amp;nbsp;&amp;bull;&amp;nbsp;'''</code>], that is, a non-breaking space, a bullet and a non-breaking space.

This template is used when you want a larger bullet than a bold middot ['''&middot;'''], but something smaller than an en dash [&ndash;].
